summary: A member backup run pending 12 hours settles needs_attention and frees the backup slot; master promotion adopts a backup repository it cannot reach as offline instead of refusing.

guide.reason: Operators see the stalled-run reason and an offline repository after a master change.

api.reason: No endpoint or field changes: run settlement gains stage run_deadline, and promotion no longer refuses on an unreachable repository.

roadmap.reason: Owner-approved behavior change inside the backup recovery plan; no milestone changes.

state.record: The backup run record (created_at, status, stage, error) and the repository record's health/access on the pool master.
state.reason: Existing durable records only; a fresh Controller reads them through the existing run and repository inventory.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent; no lab run.
